memory.note: Headline 'Recall strength' 0-100 = round(FSRS retrievability x deck maturity x 100). MEMORY-domain signals ONLY: retrievability + card-level maturity (scheduling interval). NEVER exam-topic coverage (that stays in Readiness). Hand-mirrored as constants MEMORY_* in anki-MCAT/pylib/anki/mcat_scores.py and McatScores.kt — keep in lockstep.

performance.note: Headline 0-100 = round(posterior_mean * 100) where posterior_mean = (k + prior_a0) / (n + prior_a0 + prior_b0), a Bayesian shrinkage of first-attempt correctness. Converges to raw accuracy as n grows, pulls small n toward 50, never ~100 for tiny n. Hand-mirrored as constants PERF_* in anki-MCAT/pylib/anki/mcat_scores.py and McatScores.kt — keep in lockstep.

band.note: Headline credible band: normal approximation to the Beta(k+a0, (n-k)+b0) posterior credible interval; mean +/- z*sd, sd = sqrt(a*b/((a+b)^2*(a+b+1))). Consistent with the shrinkage score; narrows as n grows.

interval.note: Wilson interval on RAW accuracy, kept as a secondary honest stat (not the headline band).

memory.message: Memory score needs at least 200 graded reviews.

performance.message: Performance score needs at least 30 attempts on unlocked topics.

readiness.message: Readiness withheld until coverage, review, and performance thresholds are met.

error_types.label: Misread / careless
error_types.next_action_template: Retry {{count}} timed questions — no new content.

readiness_mapping.note: Section accuracy on eligible topics → section band 118–132; sum → total. Widen range when coverage or attempt n is low.

study_feature.hypothesis: Interleaved performance sessions improve mixed-topic question accuracy vs blocked sessions at equal time.
